description: Stovetop fire spread to the surrounding cabinetry before being extinguished by the fire department. Significant smoke damage throughout the ground floor. No injuries reported. Family has relocated to temporary accommodation; the property is not currently habitable.

inspection.findings: Burn and char patterns identify the origin as a single cooking-fire event at the stovetop, with rapid spread to adjacent cabinetry — consistent with the fire department's incident report. No accelerant traces, no evidence of code violations, wiring intact. Smoke residue is distributed through the ground-floor rooms; water staining is limited to the suppression response. Findings are consistent with a sudden, accidental fire loss.
